executor.commit_rule: write corrected latched full word only if latch was dirty; increment count on acknowledged commit
executor.application: backlogged best-effort reads outside reserved service slots; no application writes

statistics.resource_interval: paired Student/CLT delta-method; asymptotic, not finite-sample guarantee

tuning.precomputed: all 144 ordered U pairs; switch selection at decision time H/2
tuning.rule: among candidates with one-sided pointwise 95% risk upper <= epsilon choose minimum mean complete-pass-equivalent reservation on own survivors; ties lexicographic; otherwise select minimum upper and label no certified tuning candidate; held-out test is definitive
